TREATMENT OF SEPTIC ARTHRITIS
Treatment
- Antibiotic treatment depending on bacteria isolated
- Cloxacillin or flucloxacillin - 25 mg/kg up to 1 g by IV every 6 hours
- Vancomycin - for MRSA 0.5 - 2 g/day orally divided every 6 - 8 hours
- Ceftriaxone1-2 g once daily (IM or IV) for suspected gonococcus or
meningococcus
- NSAIDs
- Surgical: daily needle aspiration, open drainage, arthroscopic debridement
with lavage, intravenous therapy for 10 -14 days and then oral antibiotics
for up to 6 weeks
Complications
- Septicaemia
- Joint ankylosis
